(February 2017) (Learn how and when to remove this message) | +-----------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ The song was recorded in April 1966 at Scepter Studios in Manhattan. The music is dominated by the piercing sound of John Cale's electric viola, creating dissonance throughout the song. Also throughout the song are loud bursts of audio feedback, primarily from Cale hissing into the microphone. Reed and Morrison's guitars in the song are tuned down a whole step, as is common with a handful of other songs on The Velvet Underground & Nico. According to Cale, Sterling Morrison refused to play bass guitar on the song because he disliked having to play it on "Venus in Furs";^([6]) Cale thus overdubbed a bassline while Morrison stuck to his usual guitar.
